account.sessionsHint: Devices currently signed in to your account.

account.emailNote: Email is sent only when your organization has configured an email server.

home.noPayslips: No payslips have been published yet.

employees.selfEditHint: You can update your contact details. Ask HR to change anything else.
employees.separationEffect: On the last working day the employee's system access ends and their direct reports move to their manager.
employees.archiveText: Use this only for records created by mistake. Employees who have left should be separated instead.
employees.pensionSchemeHint: GPSSA for UAE nationals (new scheme for registrations from 2 Oct 2023); ADPF for Abu Dhabi nationals

employees.duplicateExists: An employee with the same {{fields}} already exists ({{no}}).
employees.duplicateSuspect: A possible duplicate exists with the same {{fields}} ({{no}}). Confirm to create anyway.

warning.MANAGER_OTHER_DEPARTMENT: Saved. Note: the selected manager is in a different department and does not manage this department.

employees.notEligibleForOvertime: This employee is not eligible for overtime (managerial grade). Overtime cannot be requested.

import.title: Import employees
import.description: Upload an Excel file. Every row is checked first; nothing is saved unless all rows are valid.
import.rules: Required: first name, last name, work email, hire date. Codes must match your organization setup.
import.allValid: All {{count}} rows are valid and ready to import

documents.fileHint: PDF, image, Word or Excel up to 15 MB
documents.title: Title
documents.expiryHint: Reminders are sent 30, 14, 7 and 1 days before
documents.markConfidential: Confidential (visible only to roles with confidential access)

salary.noneHint: Payroll skips employees without a salary structure.
salary.noComponents: Only the basic salary will apply.
salary.statutoryNote: Statutory items (pension, insurance, tax) apply automatically from payroll configuration and don't need to be added here.

org.subtitle: Branches, departments, positions and the other building blocks of your organization.
org.title: Title
org.deleteText: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Items in use can't be deleted — deactivate them instead.
org.overtimeEligibleHint: Eligible for overtime (turn off for managerial grades)

attendance.subtitle: Check-ins, worked hours, late arrivals and overtime.
attendance.noneHint: Records appear when employees check in or when a day is closed.
attendance.recalcHint: Late, early-leave, overtime and status are recalculated from the employee's shift.
attendance.noRequestsHint: Requests submitted for approval appear here.
attendance.correctionHint: Your manager will review the corrected times.

leave.attachmentHint: Required for some leave types, such as sick leave with a medical certificate.
leave.autoApprove: Record as already approved (skips the approval workflow)
leave.adjustHint: Adds or removes days from a balance. The reason is kept in the audit trail.
leave.daysDeltaHint: Use a negative number to deduct
leave.calendarSubtitle: Approved and pending leave across your team.

approvals.subtitle: Review requests waiting for you and track the ones you've submitted.
approvals.inboxEmptyHint: New requests that need your decision will appear here.
approvals.delegationsHint: Let someone approve on your behalf while you're away.
approvals.delegateHint: Choose an employee who has a user account.

override.title: HR override
override.hint: You are not an approver for this step. You can decide it as an override: a comment is required, and the decision is recorded in the request history and the audit log. Any later workflow steps still apply.
override.approveTitle: Approve this step as an override?
override.rejectTitle: Reject this request as an override?
override.confirm: Explain why you are deciding on behalf of the assigned approvers. This comment is visible to the requester and auditors.

approvals.noApprover: No approver could be found. An administrator with override rights must decide this request.

workflow.subtitle: Configure who approves each kind of request, in what order, and when to escalate.
workflow.autoApproveNote: Requests that no active workflow covers go to the fallback approver, unless their type is set to approve automatically below.
workflow.priorityHint: Higher priority workflows are checked first
workflow.amountHint: Days for leave, hours for overtime, net for payroll, increase for salary
workflow.stepMinAmountHint: Leave empty to always require this step
workflow.escalateHint: Business hours: weekends and company holidays are not counted.
workflow.allowSelf: Allow the requester to approve this step themselves
workflow.noWorkflowHint: Requests without a matching active workflow go to the fallback approver. Automatic approval is opt-in per request type.
workflow.fallbackRoleHint: Everyone with this role in the company receives the request. If nobody holds it, super administrators do.
workflow.autoApproveTypes: Approve automatically when no workflow applies
workflow.autoApproveTypesHint: Leave unticked unless the request type genuinely needs no review.
workflow.autoApproveRisk: Requests of the ticked types are approved without anyone reviewing them. Each automatic approval is still recorded in the request history.
workflow.partialCoverage: These workflows have conditions. Requests that match none of them are {{otherwise}}.
workflow.autoApprovedWarning: No workflow: requests of this type are approved automatically.

payroll.subtitle: Monthly payroll runs, salaries, pay components and calculation rules.
payroll.noRunsHint: Create a run for a month to calculate payslips.
payroll.branchHint: Leave empty for the whole company
payroll.submitText: Net pay {{net}} for {{count}} employees. Attendance, leave and salaries for this period will be locked once approved.
payroll.payText: Confirms that {{net}} has been transferred. Paid payroll cannot be reopened.
payroll.reopenText: The run returns to draft so it can be corrected and recalculated. It must be approved again.
payroll.needsRecalc: Something changed since the last calculation. Recalculate before submitting.
payroll.noPayslipsHint: Calculate the run to generate payslips.
payroll.reconciledHint: Payslip lines add up to every payslip and to the run totals.
payroll.adjustmentsHint: One-off earnings or deductions for this run only, such as bonuses or advance recovery.
payroll.adjustmentAdded: Adjustment added — recalculate to apply it
payroll.skippedHint: These employees didn't get a payslip.

payComponent.configNote: Allowances, statutory deductions, insurance, pension and tax are all configured here. Nothing is hard-coded — set them to match your company policy and local law.
payComponent.defaultHint: Used when the component applies to everyone
payComponent.bracketsHint: Each band's rate applies only to the part of the base inside it.
payComponent.baseCapHint: Caps the base before a percentage
payComponent.appliesToAllLabel: Apply automatically to every eligible employee
payComponent.pensionable: Pensionable (part of the pension contribution salary)

payrollSettings.ratesHint: Used for proration, unpaid leave, absence, lateness and overtime.
payrollSettings.otNightHint: Applies to working-day overtime inside the night window
payrollSettings.otEligibilityHint: Employees in grades not eligible for overtime (e.g. managers and executives) are never paid overtime. Set eligibility under Organization → Grades or on the employee.
payrollSettings.pensionHint: Contributions are calculated on basic salary plus pensionable allowances. Overtime, bonuses and variable pay are excluded. Confirm rates with GPSSA/ADPF before changing them.

reports.subtitle: Run, chart, export and schedule reports.
reports.chooseHint: Pick a report on the left to set filters and run it.
reports.recipientsHint: Comma-separated emails; leave empty to send to yourself
reports.relativeDates: Use the previous month at delivery time

desc.overtime: Recorded and approved overtime per employee
desc.leave-balances: Entitlement, used, pending and available days

desc.headcount: Headcount, status and vacancies per department
desc.turnover: Monthly hires, separations and turnover rate
desc.document-expiry: IDs, passports, visas and certificates expiring
desc.payroll-by-department: Gross, net and employer cost by department
desc.department-comparison: Headcount, tenure, absence, overtime and cost side by side

users.employeeLinkHint: Links self-service features to this employee record

users.resetMfaText: Use this when the user has lost their authenticator device.
users.tempPasswordText: Share this password securely with {{email}}. It's shown only once and must be changed at first sign-in.
users.inviteSentText: The link is valid for 72 hours and can be used once to set a password.

roles.newHint: The role starts with self-service permissions. Add more after creating it.

scopeHint.TEAM: The user and everyone reporting to them
scopeHint.DEPARTMENT: Departments the user manages, including sub-departments
scopeHint.BRANCH: Branches and departments the user manages

roles.requireMfaHint: People with this role must set up an authenticator app at their next sign-in before they can use the app.
roles.mfaOn: Two-factor authentication is now required for this role
roles.mfaOff: Two-factor authentication is now optional for this role

settings.halfDayHint: Minutes worked below this count as a half day
settings.otApproval: Overtime is paid only after approval
settings.geoHint: Leave empty to allow mobile check-in from anywhere
settings.devicesHint: Biometric devices push punches to the API with this key and company code {{code}}.

settings.shiftsHint: Employees without a shift use the default one.

settings.leaveHint: Entitlements, accrual and rules for each kind of leave.
settings.carryHint: Unused days moved into next year
settings.minEmployeeAgeHint: Checked on the hire date. UAE law: 15 minimum; ages 15–17 only with restrictions.

audit.subtitle: Every sensitive change, sign-in and export, with who did it and when.
